title: Minimum Window Substring
prompt: Given two strings s and t of lengths m and n respectively, return the minimum window substring of s such that every character in t (including duplicates) is included in the window. If there is no such substring, return the empty string "".
constraints: s and t consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters.
hints: Sliding window. Expand right until we have all chars from t. Then shrink left to minimize while still valid.
Use a map to count required chars from t. Track 'have' vs 'need'. When have == need, we have a valid window.
Shrink left: when we have valid window, move left and decrement counts. When we lose a required char, we need to expand again.
O(n) time. Track best start and length, return the substring at the end.
